name: link
title: Link
description: Text link, always underlined in body text. External links add an icon and a hidden "(opens in a new tab)" notice.

aria: Link text is explicit out of context
external adds target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer", an icon and visually hidden "(opens in a new tab)"
Never remove the underline in running text (color alone is not enough)
a11y.notes: Use a real href. A <button> that navigates, or a <div> with a click handler, is not a link.
